hookLine: Let's rank the craziest WWE entrances of all time! From total disasters to pure goosebumps.

items.voiceLine: The Shockmaster was supposed to burst through a wall looking terrifying, and instead he tripped, fell flat on his face, and his helmet nearly popped off on live TV. Hilarious disaster. D-Tier, an all-time blooper.
John Cena's old rap entrance had him rolling up in a jersey and freestyling to the ring. Nostalgic? Sure. But also incredibly cheesy in hindsight. C-Tier, we still hum the beat though.
Triple H spitting water into the air before every single entrance became one of the most badass rituals in wrestling. Simple, intimidating, iconic. A-Tier, no notes.
And then there's The Undertaker, slowly walking out while the entire arena goes completely dark and the gong hits. Pure goosebumps every single time. S-Tier legend, no debate.

outroLine: Which entrance gave you chills? Comment below and subscribe!
